title: session streaming + speak-only voice + model-pin hygiene

claims.text: colleague session streams senses replies into the conversation, can speak while you type, and a stale model pin fails loud instead of killing the run

honesty_conditions.text: every piece (streaming, speak-only, narration, stale-pin refresh) lands inside the existing conventions — no new daemon/socket, threads stay on the sanctioned list, tests/test_boundary.py green

claims.instruction: acceptance is the transcript scenario end-to-end: hi -> long-story in colleague session; senses streams, narration lines appear during the run, stale pin refreshes instead of 404

claims.text: senses replies stream token-by-token into the conversation stream as a growing 'senses:' line — front-door direct answers, talk-lane replies, and speak-back all included; the SSE seam already exists (engines/vllm_openai.py _make_complete streams iff config.on_delta is armed)

honesty_conditions.text: streaming never changes WHAT senses says: the delivered reply equals the concatenation of streamed deltas (modulo JSON-envelope extraction) — provable by running the same turn streamed vs blocking

claims.text: transport streaming is live end-to-end: 2026-08-06 probes through the lobes gateway :8001 show incremental chunks for both the local cortex model (first chunk 0.28s) and the orin-proxied senses model (first chunk 5.31s) — the gateway no longer buffers SSE (lobes-cli#103 fixed)

the session renders incremental senses text on the conversation surface above the owned input line (the print_above cursor already exists); today's DeltaTail folds deltas into the cockpit STATUS line only — that tail stays, conversation streaming is additive

honesty_conditions.text: incremental rendering never corrupts the owned input line or the cockpit status tail; off a colour TTY (piped/--json) the session output stays byte-identical to today

claims.text: senses direct answers ride a prompted-JSON move envelope (senses_loop tools-off completion); verbatim token streaming would leak JSON syntax, so streaming needs incremental text-field extraction or a plain-text completion rung — also senses_engine_config dataclasses.replace inherits on_delta from the parent config, so an armed cortex sink would receive senses deltas unless rewired

a speak-only voice lane: a session toggle (e.g. /speak or --speak) that TTS-speaks senses conversation lines while the operator only types — voice.py synthesize + session _speak_reply already exist (today gated to voice-originated turns) and the rig tts role is ready (ResembleAI/chatterbox), so this is a gating change, not new plumbing

honesty_conditions.text: with speak-only on and /voice off, no code path constructs a voice session, opens the mic, or calls stt — TTS synthesis is the only voice.py entry point reached

claims.text: c27 stands untouched: speak-only mode never arms the mic or stt — the mic stays hot only on explicit /voice or --voice; half-duplex mute (lobes d1) is a mic-lane concern irrelevant to speak-only

honesty_conditions.text: the mic-arming gate is untouched: only --voice or /voice can create a voice/realtime session; the speak-only toggle cannot, by construction

claims.text: a model preflight: doctor (and/or a pre-run check) verifies the configured MAIN model id is in the provider's /v1/models list and names the config source that pinned it (CONVERTIBLE_MODEL/COLLEAGUE_MODEL env vs config.json vs lobes discovery) — oilcheck/three_tier.py already does exactly this membership check for the worker role; the main-model path has none

honesty_conditions.text: the preflight degrades gracefully: a provider without /v1/models, or unreachable, yields a warning/skip never a hard failure — retargeting any OpenAI-compatible server stays a config change (the vLLM-adapter carve-out rule)

claims.text: the live 404's root cause is operator env hygiene, not a code bug: a stale exported CONVERTIBLE_MODEL=sakamakismile/Qwen3.6-27B-Text-NVFP4-MTP in running shells; bashrc:174's default and the rig already agree on unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 — fixed by unset/re-source, no code change
no routing policy (v1 scope line): model resolution stays declared/discovered-by-role; the model-pin fix is diagnostics + hygiene, never an automatic task-to-model fallback

honesty_conditions.text: after the stale-pin refresh lands, model resolution inputs are still exactly {flag, env, config.json, lobes role discovery} — no code path reads task content to pick a model

claims.text: stale-pin refresh (q2): a pinned model id the provider no longer serves is STALE CONFIG, not a reason to die — with lobes armed, colleague resolves the SAME role's currently-discovered id and proceeds, loudly (a recorded warning names the stale pin, its source, and the refreshed id); not a fallback and never a routing decision: the intended target (the role) never changed, only its id rotated

honesty_conditions.text: the refresh fires ONLY when the provider explicitly reports the pinned id unserved (404 model_not_found, or absence from /v1/models), stays within the SAME role, and records a warning naming the stale id + its source + the refreshed id; with lobes unarmed or the role advertising no model, the original error surfaces unchanged

revisions.text: same-role model degrade (q2): when the pinned/configured model returns model_not_found and lobes is armed, colleague degrades to the model the gateway advertises under the SAME role (cortex pin stale -> discovered cortex model), loudly — a recorded warning names the stale pin and its source; the role assignment never changes, so this is id substitution within a declared role, not task-to-model routing

claims.text: probed live 2026-08-06: the senses model streams its JSON move envelope as a ```json fence with the text field contiguous but chunk boundaries splitting mid-key ('{"move', '": "') — incremental extraction is a small fence-tolerant state machine that withholds the closing quote/brace/fence, never a regex over complete JSON

TTS decoupling: _speak_reply is gated on a live voice session and play_wav_bytes takes that session to hold the half-duplex gate — speak-only needs a playback path WITHOUT a voice session (no mic means no half-duplex gate to hold), and typing stays live during playback (the input reader thread keeps the owned line responsive)

honesty_conditions.text: with speak-only on, playback runs with NO voice session object in existence; a synth or playback failure leaves the rendered text byte-identical (the existing degrade-never-raise contract)

claims.text: speak-only is per-session opt-in, default OFF — audio out is a side channel (office speakers); mirrors c27's spirit on the speaker side

honesty_conditions.text: no config default, profile, or mode flips speak-only on without an explicit per-session opt-in (flag or slash toggle)
